```{r}
df_franchise_history=nba_franchise_history()

Sys.setenv("VROOM_CONNECTION_SIZE" = 8000000)
dataGameLogsTeam=game_logs(seasons = seq(1947,2026,1),
  league = "NBA",
  result_types = "team",
  season_types = "Regular Season")

write.csv(dataGameLogsTeam,"20260404_nbagamelogs.csv",row.names=FALSE)

assign_nba_teams()

teamnames=df_dict_nba_teams%>%
  select(nameTeam,idTeam)

# Calculate from today backwards.
test2=dataGameLogsTeam%>%
  arrange(idTeam,desc(yearSeason),desc(numberGameTeamSeason))%>%
  group_by(idTeam)%>%
  mutate(cumWins=cumsum(isWin),
         cumLosses=cumsum(isWin==FALSE),
         cumGames=row_number())%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(statrec=cumWins/sum(cumWins,cumLosses),
         dif500=statrec-0.5,
         absdif500=abs(statrec-0.5))%>%
  ungroup()

test3=merge(test2,df_dict_nba_teams,by="idTeam")

# Calculate from past onwards.
#test3=dataGameLogsTeam%>%arrange(idTeam,numberGameTeamSeason)%>%
#  group_by(idTeam)%>%
#  mutate(cumWins=cumsum(isWin),
#                     cumLosses=cumsum(isWin==FALSE))%>%
#  rowwise()%>%
#  mutate(statrec=cumWins/sum(cumWins,cumLosses))

ggplot(test3%>%filter(yearPlayedLast==2025),
       aes(x=cumGames,y=statrec))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point(data=test3%>%
               filter(yearPlayedLast==2025)%>%
               filter(statrec==0.5),
             color="red")+
  facet_wrap(~nameTeam.y,ncol=5)

ggplot(test3%>%filter(yearPlayedLast==2025),
      aes(y=nameTeam.y,x=dif500))+
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE)+
  geom_vline(xintercept=0,linetype="dashed")

test4=test3%>%
  filter(yearPlayedLast==2025)%>%
  group_by(idTeam,nameTeam.y)%>%
  summarize(fhun=sum(statrec==0.5),
            fhun_norm=fhun/max(cumGames))

test5=test3%>%
  filter(nameTeam.y=="Atlanta Hawks"&
           statrec==0.5)

yo=test3 %>%
  filter(yearPlayedLast==2025)%>%
  group_by(idTeam,nameTeam.y) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(statrec),
    p_value = t.test(statrec, mu = 0.5)$p.value,
    t_stat = t.test(statrec, mu = 0.5)$statistic)
  
ggplot()
```
### Import data
```{r mvp}
topdf=data.frame()
for (i in list.files("data/")){
  # First name
  fn=str_split_i(i,"_",1)
  # Surname
  sn=str_split_i(i,"_",2)
  filename=paste("data/",i,sep="")
  data=read.csv(filename)
  # Remove last row with totals.
  last=nrow(data)-1
  # Get year of MVP.
  year=str_split_i(data[last-1,"Date"],"-",1)
  data=data[1:last,]
  # Remove column with @
  data=data%>%select(-c("X"))
  # Keep games played.
  data=data%>%filter(is.na(Gcar)==FALSE)
  # Calculate FT/PTS proportion.
  data$FT=as.numeric(data$FT)
  data$PTS=as.numeric(data$PTS)
  data=data%>%mutate(ftprop=FT/PTS,
                     first_name=fn,
                     surname=sn,
                     mvp_year=year)
  topdf=rbind(topdf,data)
}

ggplot(topdf,aes(x=mvp_year,y=ftprop))+
  geom_boxplot(outliers=FALSE)+
  geom_beeswarm()
```
